Patch log is empty (applied=0, skipped=0, conflicts=0) but critics returned 34 findings and the final report exists. The patcher's log was almost certainly lost in transit — Layer 6 orchestrator didn't pre-create `research/patch-log.json` as an empty stub, so the tool-locked patcher (`[Read, Edit]` only) couldn't populate it and inlined the log in its Task result instead. The draft WAS patched — you can verify via `git diff` on the L4 draft snapshot — but the audit trail is gone. Fix: orchestrator must `echo '{"applied":[], "skipped":[], "conflicts":[]}' > research/patch-log.json` before spawning the patcher.

6 atomic entity/entities from prompt-decomposition.json are missing from the final report: MITRE ATT&CK (Enterprise, Mobile, ICS), ATT&CK STIX 2.1 release corpus, TTP-based threat-actor attribution, CTI benchmarks and training corpora (CTIBench, TRAM, rcATT), Detection and mitigation coverage claims, ATT&CK-Norm normalization protocol. The draft drifted from the user's explicit ask. Re-spawn the instruction-critic with the missing items flagged, or hand-craft Edits to restore them.

Required format(s) from prompt-decomposition not visibly present in draft: journal manuscript structure with numbered sections, quantitative results tables, figures referenced by number, explicit threats-to-validity section, reproducibility statement. This may be a false positive if the format is rendered without the spec word in the prose — review manually.
Tag 'gap' is used by only 1 note. Consider merging.
